#: Scrub manifest for the logs collector: one payload, the parsed journal entries `_run_journalctl(['-r','-n','100'])` returns, committed under the stem the replay seam slugs from those arguments (r---n--100.json). The document is a LIST of entries, so every entry starts at a list index and is matched by '*'. The field set below is the union observed on an Ubuntu 26.04 lab guest at systemd 259; a journal from a host running other software carries fields this file does not classify, and the walk's deny-by-default refusal is what will force it to grow rather than trusting anyone to remember.
#BLOCKED: THIS MANIFEST DOES NOT CURRENTLY PASS se-anonymise, AND NO logs VARIANT IS COMMITTED. Three leaves — MESSAGE, SYSLOG_RAW and _CMDLINE — are unbounded free text, so they take the free-text pass, and the pass legitimately finds nothing to substitute in most of their values: measured on the capture this file was written beside, 35 of 77 distinct MESSAGE values, 9 of 11 _CMDLINE values and 7 of 7 SYSLOG_RAW values came back unchanged. se-anonymise's survived-unchanged gate refuses every one of them, because for a SHAPED field an unengaged substitution really is no scrub at all. For an unbounded prose field it is the ordinary case: the pass substitutes tokens INSIDE the value, and 'this sentence contained no token' is a legitimate outcome rather than a failure. The gate cannot express that distinction, and the manifest cannot express it either — which is why this file is committed refusing rather than quietly reclassified.
#WHY_NOT_nothing: The obvious way through is to classify the three as `nothing` with a stated bound, the way packages.json bounds archive-wide package names and traefik.json bounds Traefik's internal router names. It was rejected on evidence, not on principle. `nothing` means verbatim and runs no pass at all, so every token inside those values would be published as captured — and the capture behind this file carries a username, a client address and an ssh public-key fingerprint inside MESSAGE. Two of those three the independent detectors would catch on the committed corpus; the username and the fingerprint they would not, because neither has a shape. And the contamination is not removable by capturing more carefully: se-capture-guest reaches the guest over ssh and runs the read under sudo, so the newest entries ALWAYS include this session's own pam and sudo lines. There is no capture of this interface, over this transport, for which `nothing` is true.
#OWED: A ruling, not a workaround. Either the scrubber gains a way for a manifest to declare a leaf as unbounded free text — the pass runs, an empty result is legitimate, and the independent detectors keep owning the shapes — or this collector's corpus is captured by some route other than an interactive session, or the journal payload is ruled unpublishable and the collector is judged by the live comparator alone. Whichever it is, it is a decision about what the public corpus may hold, and that is not a manifest's to make.
#identity: Everything journald mints to correlate: the machine id, the boot id, the per-invocation ids, the journal file's own sequence-number id, the stdout stream id, and the CURSOR — which embeds the sequence-number id and the boot id and is also the object name every row is published under, so it must scrub consistently with the fields it quotes or the specimen teaches a join that does not exist. All are 32-hex or embed it, which is the shape the keyed replacement marks with 5cb0.
#MESSAGE_ID_is_nothing: MESSAGE_ID is 32 hex and is NOT identity. It is the emitter's own catalogue id for a message TYPE, compiled into the software — the same digits on every machine running systemd, and published in systemd's own catalogue. Substituting it would break the repetition join this collection exists to teach (two entries differing only in an interpolated value share it) while protecting nothing, which is the blanket-substitution failure DESIGN 21 names.
#location: _HOSTNAME is the machine's own name, which is where it sits in this estate. It takes format hostname, so the leaf value IS the name and is substituted whole.
#nothing: Priorities, facilities, transports, timestamps in every spelling, pids, tids, uids, gids, session and job numbers, capability masks, systemd's own source file/function/line, unit and slice names, cgroup paths, and the logind class/type vocabulary. These are states, counts and the distribution's own words: the same strings on every machine running the same software. THE BOUND IS STATED because it is a decision and not a shape — a unit an operator wrote themselves carries a name somebody chose, which is content, and a capture holding one moves these entries rather than surviving them.
#later-leaves: Three members the first capture host did not emit and this one does. `USER_INVOCATION_ID` is systemd's invocation id for a USER unit — the same 32-hex identity as INVOCATION_ID beside it, and deliberately not exempt just because it is rarer; it is not a catalogue constant, so the independent detectors flag it unless it is substituted, which is the deny-by-default property working. `USERSPACE_USEC` is how long userspace took to start, a duration. `_SELINUX_CONTEXT` is `unconfined` on a host with no policy loaded — a policy word, identical everywhere SELinux is not enforcing. STATED BOUND: on a host that IS enforcing, that member carries a user and role (`unconfined_u:unconfined_r:...`), which is identity, and this entry must be revisited before such a capture is scrubbed.
#a-unit-that-failed: Four fields systemd adds only when a unit actually fails, so no capture of a quiet machine could hold them and no manifest could have classified them until corpus/logs/severity was staged. UNIT_RESULT and EXIT_CODE are systemd's own closed vocabularies (exit-code, signal, timeout; exited, killed, dumped) and EXIT_STATUS is the number the process returned — none is a fact about this estate. COMMAND names the DIRECTIVE that failed, `ExecStart`, and is prose rather than nothing because the member's name says command and a future systemd that put a command LINE there must get the free-text pass rather than a silent exemption.
